configuration.date_resolution: Yearless day/month dates: month >= rollover_month -> season_start_year, otherwise season_start_year + 1. Real Excel dates and serials are used as recorded (workbook epoch respected). No timezone conversion.

units.duration_min: minutes (from Excel day fractions x 1440, timedelta, or h:mm:ss text)
units.avg_movement_intensity: source-defined; unit and vendor formula not established
units.mip1: 'Maximal Intensity Period MI 1min': peak 1-minute movement intensity, source-defined unit. A per-session peak, so daily values are the max over sessions, never a sum
units.mip3: 'Maximal Intensity Period MI 3min': as mip1 over a 3-minute window
units.efficiency: Movement Load AU per TRIMP index point (daily, calculated)
units.trimp_per_min: TRIMP index per minute (daily, calculated); session values are source-reported
units.measurement_error_pct: percent points, interpreted from cell format and column header
units.dates: ISO 8601 calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, local date as recorded (no timezone shift)
units.wellness: unknown scale, direction and unit; stored exactly as recorded

fieldDictionary.nullability: null = missing or unusable. 0 = a recorded zero. Never interchangeable. No value is filled with zero.
fieldDictionary.provenance: Every raw, cleaned and wellness record has provenance {file, sheet, excel_row}; record_id = <first 12 hex of file SHA-256>:<fd|wl>-<excel row>.

record_status.excluded: kept but not counted (exact_duplicate or manual_override)
record_status.rejected: no usable athlete or date; visible but cannot be aggregated

completeness.complete: every included session of the day has the metric
completeness.partial: some sessions have it; value is the sum of the known values only
completeness.missing: no session has it; value is null
completeness.no_sessions: breakdown bucket has no sessions that day; value is null

fieldDictionary.peak_intensity: dailyRecords[].peak_intensity.<mip1|mip3> is a metric block whose value is the MAX over included sessions that recorded it, plus by_bucket (training, game, other) blocks of the same shape.
fieldDictionary.derived_ratios: efficiency = total Movement Load / total TRIMP; trimp_per_min = total TRIMP / total duration. Only when both inputs are complete over the same sessions and the denominator > 0; otherwise value null with a reason. Session ratios are never averaged.
fieldDictionary.source_reported: acute_training_load, chronic_training_load and acwr are copied from the source system for reference only. They are NOT recalculated or validated.
fieldDictionary.history: athletes[].history lists observed dates and gaps. Gaps are unobserved, not rest or zero.
fieldDictionary.duplicates: Exact duplicates (all source cells identical) keep the first record as canonical; copies are excluded with duplicate_of. Possible duplicates (overlapping or same-start sessions) stay included with a warning until reviewed.

history.gap_policy: Gaps are days with no recorded session. They are NOT zero load and NOT confirmed rest days; downstream rolling metrics must choose a policy.
